description: Observable on any bump: the release brief carrying the devDependencies change cites an already-edited L7 section whose new log row reads 'pending verification'. A brief that bumps the pin without a preceding spec edit fails this criterion; so does a shipped bump whose pending row was never completed with the e2e findings.
text: A peer-SDK dev-pin bump appears in the spec — the L7 pin plus a Verified-pin-log row — before the matching devDependencies change ships in a release brief.
title: A peer-SDK dev-pin bump appears in the spec — the L7 pin plus a Verified-pin-log row — before the matching devDependencies change ships in a release brief.
